title: Moisture-induced degradation pathways in halide perovskite solar cells
items.abstract: We show that moisture initiates halide migration in perovskite films, accelerating degradation of solar cells, and evaluate barrier strategies.

title: Defect passivation strategies for stable perovskite photovoltaics
items.abstract: A review of defect passivation, including Lewis-base additives, that improves the operational stability of halide perovskite devices.
